name: Dundalk Leisurecraft Luna 2-4 Person Cube Cabin Sauna
description: Experience Tranquility with the Luna Sauna – The Ultimate Home Retreat Introducing the Canadian Timber Luna Sauna by Dundalk Leisurecraft, a beautifully crafted 2-4 person cube cabin sauna that combines timeless design with modern comfort. Handcrafted in Canada using premium Eastern White Cedar, the Luna Sauna offers a peaceful escape to unwind and rejuvenate, while adding a touch of elegance to any outdoor space. Key Features High-Quality Eastern White Cedar Sustainably sourced, this light-colored cedar is valued for its natural decay resistance, insulation properties, and refreshing aroma, making it ideal for saunas. EPDM Sloped Roof Equipped with an EPDM membrane roof, the sloped design ensures water drainage and enhances durability for long-lasting use. Front Window with Bronze Tempered Glass The front window features double 5mm bronze-tempered glass, allowing natural light to enter while maintaining privacy. Solid Wood Benches Comfortable for small gatherings, allowing ample space to sit up or lie down on sturdy solid wood benches. Features: 2-4 person capacity Made in Canada 6 kW electric heater recommended, or wood burning Lead Times Dundalk Leisurecraft saunas are luxurious saunas handcrafted in Canada with sustainably sourced Canadian lumber. Due to this, these saunas are made to order, which means there isn't any inventory. Current lead time is 6-8 weeks to ship. 3-Year Warranty The Canadian Timber Collection by Dundalk LeisureCraft Inc. is warranted against defects in materials and workmanship under normal/residential use for a period of three (3) years, as applicable, from the date of receipt of the product. This warranty does not apply to normal wear and tear and/or natural weather conditions. This warranty does not cover regular required maintenance. Refer to your assembly manual for maintenance guidelines. This warranty does not cover misuse or negligence and the manufacturer and associated retailers are not liable for any injury or damage caused by the product. This warranty is a parts-only warranty and any service or labor costs would not be considered as part of the 3-year warranty. Videos Useful Links Click the links below to see more detailed info about the CTC22LU sauna. Product Drawing Assembly Instructions Dundalk Leisurecraft Residential Shipping Information Dundalk Leisurecraft Residential Shipping Additional Shipping Charges Transform Your Space with the Luna Sauna Create your own retreat and enjoy the benefits of a handcrafted Canadian sauna. The Luna Sauna by Dundalk Leisurecraft provides a luxurious setting to unwind, detox, and rejuvenate in the comfort of your own backyard. Indulge in the warmth and tranquility of a premium sauna experience with this expertly crafted sauna cube.
